integrity.result: Self-contained analytic proof and deterministic finite tests; no claim of independent validation. Original claims are limited to the new quantitative sharp two-sided interval comparison and consequences.

scientific_limitations: Specific to exponentiated-exponential lifetime laws, not arbitrary PRHR baselines.
The uniform constants are optimal for quantile increments, not claimed optimal for scalar variance ratios.
Qualitative star-order and variance-monotonicity comparisons were already known.
The Giam 2026 abstract but not its complete full text was accessible; bibliographic coverage cannot be guaranteed.
No independent audit has been performed.
title: Sharp two-sided logarithmic quantile contraction for exponentiated-exponential lifetimes
